parameters.query:
WITH stale_initial AS (
  UPDATE leads
  SET initial_response_delivery_status = 'uncertain'
  WHERE initial_response_delivery_status = 'sending'
    AND initial_response_claim_token IS NOT NULL
    AND initial_response_claimed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND initial_response_claimed_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
  RETURNING id
), stale_followups AS (
  UPDATE leads
  SET followup_status = 'uncertain'
  WHERE followup_status = 'sending'
    AND followup_claimed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND followup_claimed_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
  RETURNING id
), stale_claimed AS (
  UPDATE flowpilot_idempotency
  SET status = 'failed',
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE status = 'processing'
    AND workflow_stage = 'claimed'
    AND stage_updated_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 minutes'
  RETURNING idempotency_key
), stale_business_started AS (
  UPDATE flowpilot_idempotency
  SET status = 'recovery_required',
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE status = 'processing'
    AND workflow_stage = 'business_started'
    AND stage_updated_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 minutes'
  RETURNING idempotency_key
), safe_business_complete AS (
  UPDATE flowpilot_idempotency
  SET status = 'completed',
      completed_at = NOW(),
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE status = 'processing'
    AND workflow_stage = 'business_complete'
    AND stage_updated_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 minutes'
    AND (CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(response_payload) = 'object' THEN
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(response_payload)) = 4
      AND response_payload ?& ARRAY['success', 'route', 'message', 'analysis']::text[]
      AND (response_payload->'success') = 'true'::jsonb
      AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'route') = 'string'
      AND response_payload->>'route' IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')
      AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'message') = 'string'
      AND CASE
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis') = 'object' THEN
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(response_payload->'analysis')) = 5
          AND (response_payload->'analysis') ?& ARRAY['category', 'priority', 'lead_score', 'short_summary', 'recommended_action']::text[]
          AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'category') = 'string'
          AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'priority') = 'string'
          AND response_payload->'analysis'->>'priority' IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')
          AND response_payload->>'route' = response_payload->'analysis'->>'priority'
          AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'short_summary') = 'string'
          AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'recommended_action') = 'string'
          AND CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'lead_score') = 'number'
              AND response_payload->'analysis'->>'lead_score' ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,2})$'
            THEN (response_payload->'analysis'->>'lead_score')::integer BETWEEN 0 AND 100
            ELSE FALSE
          END
        ELSE FALSE
      END
    ELSE FALSE
  END)
  RETURNING idempotency_key
), unsafe_business_complete AS (
  UPDATE flowpilot_idempotency
  SET status = 'recovery_required',
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE status = 'processing'
    AND workflow_stage = 'business_complete'
    AND stage_updated_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 minutes'
    AND NOT (CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(response_payload) = 'object' THEN
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(response_payload)) = 4
      AND response_payload ?& ARRAY['success', 'route', 'message', 'analysis']::text[]
      AND (response_payload->'success') = 'true'::jsonb
      AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'route') = 'string'
      AND response_payload->>'route' IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')
      AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'message') = 'string'
      AND CASE
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis') = 'object' THEN
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(response_payload->'analysis')) = 5
          AND (response_payload->'analysis') ?& ARRAY['category', 'priority', 'lead_score', 'short_summary', 'recommended_action']::text[]
          AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'category') = 'string'
          AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'priority') = 'string'
          AND response_payload->'analysis'->>'priority' IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')
          AND response_payload->>'route' = response_payload->'analysis'->>'priority'
          AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'short_summary') = 'string'
          AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'recommended_action') = 'string'
          AND CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'lead_score') = 'number'
              AND response_payload->'analysis'->>'lead_score' ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,2})$'
            THEN (response_payload->'analysis'->>'lead_score')::integer BETWEEN 0 AND 100
            ELSE FALSE
          END
        ELSE FALSE
      END
    ELSE FALSE
  END)
  RETURNING idempotency_key
), stale_legacy_processing AS (
  UPDATE flowpilot_idempotency
  SET status = 'recovery_required',
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE status = 'processing'
    AND workflow_stage IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(stage_updated_at, updated_at, created_at) <= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 minutes'
  RETURNING idempotency_key
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stale_initial) AS initial_quarantined,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stale_followups) AS followups_quarantined,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stale_claimed) AS claimed_failed,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stale_business_started) AS partial_recovery_required,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safe_business_complete) AS safely_completed,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unsafe_business_complete) AS unsafe_recovery_required,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stale_legacy_processing) AS legacy_recovery_required;
